releaseOwner.name: MaxJafar
releaseOwner.note: Release owner instructed this 1.0.0 release directly. Recorded here so the approval is auditable rather than implied.

licenceCompliance.note: Apache-2.0 declared in the root LICENSE and all 13 package LICENSE files, verified byte-identical to the canonical text apart from the copyright line. No CLA and no trademark regime exist, so neither is attested.

deferredChannels.reason: No Apple Developer ID or Windows signing certificate has been procured, so no notarized DMG, signed MSI, deb or AppImage exists. The native release policy still requires a verified upgrade from an older signed installer before any stable native artifact ships.
The Tauri updater channel depends on signed native artifacts and is deferred with them.
Packages are version-locked and pack cleanly, but publication requires the maintainer's npm account and GitHub Actions OIDC on the canonical tag workflow.

notes: This record covers the source, CLI, MCP plugin and npm-packable surfaces at 1.0.0. It deliberately does not claim any signed native artifact.
Design-partner and CLA/trademark legal gates were retired in this release; see docs/adr/0002-stable-release-acceptance.md.
